    下洋 · 狗仔日記

    Ha Yeung Dog Days

    You're a golden retriever living in Ha Yeung village, Clear Water Bay. The hills, roads and houses follow real map data: run downhill along Ha Yeung Road to the sea, or up to the bus stop on Clear Water Bay Road. Hail a green minibus, dig for treasure, collect sticks and stones, raid a neighbour's BBQ and a beach picnic, chase the bus, play fetch, beg for dim sum, and nap in the sun. When the bus pulls in, hop on and ride to Discovery Bay, where the residents drive golf carts. So can you.
